name: hud_ui_net_exit_panel_create_global
description: HudUiNetExitPanel::CreateGlobal allocates, constructs, stores, and returns the global NETEXIT panel singleton.
known_limits: Binary Ninja still exposes MSVC EH scaffolding around the allocation path; byte-safe verification is deferred to a coherent HudUiNetExitPanel/HUD background class pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja evidence for 0x41c000 validates allocation of 0xabec bytes, calling HudUiNetExitPanel::HudUiNetExitPanel when allocation succeeds, storing the constructed pointer in g_HudUiNetExitPanel, returning the same pointer, and storing/returning null on allocation failure.

The native smoke verifies CreateGlobal returns a non-null constructed panel, stores the same pointer in g_HudUiNetExitPanel, and observes the constructor-initialized disabled/non-joystick state. The smoke installs a test video surface dispatch because construction reaches HudUiBackground::LoadZrdAndSection.
